class: A list of refusal wordings that the model's newer phrasings slip past
symptom: Ciena on Workday, 30 September: 'I am unable to answer this question as the provided...' was typed into the Facebook box, and the AI also offered 'Yaswanth Reddy Jonnalagadda does not have a professional Twitter account'.
root_cause: claude_integration._NON_ANSWER knew 'not provided', 'I don't know', 'the resume does not say' -- not 'I am unable to', 'cannot answer', or a third-person '<name> does not have ...'.
why_tests_missed: The non-answer tests used Claude's usual wordings; Gemini words its refusals differently.
fix: _NON_ANSWER also matches 'I am/I'm unable/not able to ...', '(do not|cannot) answer/provide ...', and any short '... does not have/hold/say/mention ...' statement about the candidate; the one check (is_non_answer) keeps them out of every form box.
prevention: Refusals are recognised by their shape (first-person inability, third-person statements about the candidate), not by one model's phrasing; every provider's outputs go through the same check.
